The missing key is `rate`. `settings.json:2` spells it `"rat"` (a typo), so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` in `app/pricing.py:8` returns `None`.

`app/config.py` loads `settings.json` unchanged into `SETTINGS`, so the typo comes straight from the JSON file. Renaming `"rat"` to `"rate"` would fix it. I haven't modified any files.
